image_description: A side-profile view of a modern, custom-styled electric golf cart. The vehicle features a metallic orange/bronze body with black accents and a beige fabric canopy. It has two bucket-style seats rather than a traditional bench, a visible steering wheel, and small wheels with turf tires. The background shows a building facade with stone steps and potted plants.

The texture of the grey seats is overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking realistic fabric stitching or leather grain. The floor matting has a repetitive, slightly blurred pattern that doesn't align perfectly with the perspective.
The front windshield pillar appears slightly warped where it meets the roofline, and the thickness of the pillars varies inconsistently along their length.
